mainEntity.name: What preparation is needed before interior painters begin work?

acceptedAnswer.text: Before interior painters start, surfaces must be clean, dry, and free of dust or debris. This often involves cleaning, patching holes, sanding, and priming, especially in older homes common in Berkeley and Oakland. Furnishings and non-removable items need to be covered or moved. Frasheski Construction's coordination includes managing these preparation steps, ensuring the space is fully ready for painting to achieve optimal adhesion and a smooth finish. Proper preparation is critical for the longevity and quality of the paint job.
acceptedAnswer.description: Preparation includes cleaning, patching, sanding, and priming surfaces. All furnishings must be covered or moved. Frasheski Construction manages these steps for optimal results.
